import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Basic feature engineering (verified working)
def engineer_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["f_27_len"] = df["f_27"].str.len()
    df["f_27_unique"] = df["f_27"].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    df["f_27_first"] = df["f_27"].str[0]
    df["f_27_last"] = df["f_27"].str[-1]

    int_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)]
    df["int_sum"] = df[int_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["int_mean"] = df[int_cols].mean(axis=1)
    df["int_std"] = df[int_cols].std(axis=1)

    cont_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]
    df["cont_sum"] = df[cont_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["cont_mean"] = df[cont_cols].mean(axis=1)

    return df


train_df = engineer_features(train_df)
test_df = engineer_features(test_df)

# Identify feature columns (exclude id, target, and f_27 string column after encoding)
exclude_cols = ["id", "target", "f_27"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Encode categorical columns
cat_cols = ["f_27_first", "f_27_last"]
for col in cat_cols:
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].astype("category")
    test_df[col] = test_df[col].astype("category")

# Prepare data
X = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y = train_df["target"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Split for validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create LGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, categorical_feature=cat_cols)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data, categorical_feature=cat_cols
)

# Faster parameters (reduced complexity, early stopping)
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 0.1,
}

# Train with fewer rounds and early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=200,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validation prediction and AUC
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Test prediction and submission
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
